hypothesis: A single calibrated nonlinear model can use causally available Binance leveraged-positioning state to distinguish a genuine forced-inventory continuation from a failed completed Bybit internal-structure break, with incremental probability quality and positive realistic-cost account expectancy.
external_information_venue: Binance USDT-margined perpetual public historical metrics

event.trigger: first completed 15-minute close through an already-confirmed active internal pivot
event.target: nearest still-unreached already-confirmed hourly pivot beyond the reference price in the break direction
event.entry: first Bybit minute open at least 60 seconds after both the completed decision bar and the selected Binance metrics timestamp

model.pooling: BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT with symbol indicator
model.calibration: chronological Platt logistic calibration on raw-probability log odds

structure_features: direction-aligned body efficiency and wick skew
incremental_positioning_features: direction-aligned top-account, top-position, all-account and taker long-short log ratios
top-position minus top-account and crowd divergence

account.open_position_nav: realistic liquidation value including hypothetical exit cost
account.top_winner_removal: remove top 10 percent of completed trades by account PnL and replay the global event ledger so freed slots may take later candidates

failure_rule: If any gate fails, calendar 2023 remains sealed and the exact information unit is killed without threshold, side, symbol, feature, risk, leverage or sizing salvage.
